note: item stat lines that move no Details row (missing-data/09 items 3 and 4); Code, not checked in game

bDamageLimit.summary: NOT a condition marker (gear.json limitRules `unknown` was wrong). It is a number: `EnemyMobActionManagerBase.GemDamageLimit(damage, playerActionManager)` clamps one hit on a High Raid subjugation target.
bDamageLimit.formula: if value != 0 and FieldManager.RoomType == 28 (FieldRoomType.HighRaid) and HighRaidRoomData.CheckSubjugationTarget(target mob unique id, the parent mob when the target is a dummy): damage = min(damage, int(value / 10 / 100 * target MaxHp))
bDamageLimit.label: Code
bDamageLimit.calculator: no gear condition to evaluate: drop `limit_assumed`; the line is a per-hit damage cap (fraction value/1000 of the target's Max HP) that only exists in High Raid

bElement.detailsRow: MaxMp (only when the main weapon element is Mana 8, see mastery_reach.json weaponElement)
bElement.summary: Read through BonusManager.GetEquipElement(slot) = the value of the slot's bElement line (player_status/bonus_overrides.py). Consumers: the element of every attack and of the damage resist (PlayerAttackBase.InitializeElement / GetWeaponElementType / CalcNormalElementWeaponDamageResistRate), skill OnInitialize of ~150 action classes (PlayerStatusBase.GetEquipElement), ElementReach.TryGetWeaponElement, ChargingAction.CalcChargingCastTime, NormalAttackAction.calcDualSwordDamage and PlayerSecondaryStatus.CalcBaseMaxMp.
bElement.via: BonusManager.GetEquipElement(slot) (not an accessor with a BonusType argument, so bonus_readers.py shows none)
bElement.label: Code
bElement.calculator: already an input (weaponElement / subWeaponElement); no further Details row

bItemDelay.summary: Item use delay: `MainPlayer.CalcItemDelay(time, bonus)` (and MobaPlayer.CalcItemDelay): with bonus=true and the buffer present, itemDelay = nowItemDelayTime = max(time * (1 + GetParam(140) / -10 / 100), 5); otherwise time. GetParam returns Value, the summed line value capped at 500, so value 100 = -10 % delay.
bItemDelay.label: Code
bItemDelay.calculator: a result section 'item delay' could show time * (1 - min(sum, 500) / 1000); the item base delay (`time`) comes from the item master

bHelpMaster.summary: In PlayerBattleManager.OnSkillActionStart: when EquipBuffManager.IsVilidEquipBuff(143), value = GetParam(143) (the summed line value capped at 10) is converted to float and passed to FirstAidBuf.ValidInvincible(time), which sets LeftTime = time and the invincible flag (_flag |= 0x1000) on the First Aid buff that the same function adds with SkillBufferManager.AddSelfBuffer.
bHelpMaster.formula: First Aid buff invincibility time = min(sum of lines, 10) (seconds, Inferred unit: LeftTime is seconds everywhere else)
bHelpMaster.label: Code (trigger condition of the surrounding branch: Inferred)
bHelpMaster.calculator: a result section can show 'First Aid invincibility: min(sum, 10) s'

bGemDustDropRate.summary: No function in libil2cpp reads it: not through any BonusManager / EquipBuffManager accessor with the constant 177 (bonus_readers.py), and the neighbouring drop lines bGemDropFixing (190) have none either. bExpRate (PlayerSecondaryStatus.GetExpBonus) and bDropRate (GetDropBonus) are read by the client for display; the gem dust drop roll is a drop rate, which PROJECT.md 'Hard limits' lists as server-side.
bGemDustDropRate.label: Code (absence); consumer = server: Inferred
bGemDustDropRate.calculator: show the line value only; no client formula exists

bMagicBarrier.detailsRow: none as a stat; the Details panel lists a running barrier (UIPlayerStatusDetailPanel.AddBarrierStatus reads skill buffers 2 / 3)
bMagicBarrier.summary: Creates the barrier skill buffer 3 (SkillBufferManager.TryGetBuf(.., 3)). It absorbs damage of MobMagicAttack in MobAttackBase.CalcBarrier(damage, playerAction, mobAction); MobAttackBase.GetBarrierType maps the attack class to the line (MobNormalAttack -> 159, MobMagicAttack -> 160, MobMaxHPRateAttack / MobCurrentHPRateAttack -> 161) and GetBarrierBuf to the buffer (2, 3, 4). Also read in MobAttackPlayerSelfDestruct.calcMobToPlayerDamage via EquipBuffManager.CalcBuff.
bMagicBarrier.label: Code (absorb rule: the buffer's remaining value is returned by a virtual slot, summary Inferred)
bMagicBarrier.calculator: barrier pools; only act when a mob attack hits

bPhysicalBarrier.summary: Same mechanism as bMagicBarrier for MobNormalAttack: skill buffer 2, CalcBarrier / GetBarrierBuf / GetBarrierType (159). No constant-id accessor read exists; the equipment buffer's Calc hook creates / refreshes the skill buffer (equip_buffers.json id 159, hook Calc reads TryGetBuf(1098)).
bPhysicalBarrier.label: Code

bRateBarrier.summary: Same mechanism for MobMaxHPRateAttack and MobCurrentHPRateAttack: skill buffer 4, selected by MobAttackBase.GetBarrierType (161).
bRateBarrier.label: Code
